label: The last train
text: We missed the last train, so we walked home along the river.

label: More lemon
text: I added a little more lemon to the soup, and suddenly it tasted just like my mother's.

label: A long day
text: I thought she was upset with me, but it turned out she'd just had a really long day.

label: Twenty dollars
text: The tickets were twenty dollars each, so the four of us split the cost of a taxi instead.

label: By the door
text: Every morning, the dog waits by the door with his leash before I've even finished getting dressed.

label: Morning coffee
text: I could smell the coffee from the hallway, and I knew my brother was already awake.

label: Past the bakery
text: If you go past the bakery and take the next left, you'll see the entrance to the park.

label: She got the job
text: When she told us she'd got the job, we opened the good bottle we'd been saving.

label: Rain at the beach
text: It started raining just as we reached the beach, but the kids ran straight into the water anyway.

label: The first notes
text: He played the first few notes on the piano, and everyone in the room started singing along.
